column2:
Limited deal pipeline or selection of
low-impact projects - often due to the
lack of a long-term master plan that can
bridge political cycles. A shorter-term
focus may result in the unwillingness to
develop larger, more impactful projects,
as well as inadequate infrastructure-policy
frameworks leading to poor prioritization of
infrastructure projects.
column3:
TC team is actively engaged in developing
high impact projects both long and short
term with attractive returns. This provides
an attractive avenue for investors to gain
exposure to African infrastructure.
